title: Our story
content:
Our story

Clothes worth keeping

We make a small collection of well-made clothing and accessories, and we stand behind every piece.

Since 2014

We started with one coat and a list of things we wished it did better

Our founder spent a winter taking apart the coats she loved, to see why some lasted and others did not. The answer was never the label. It was the cloth, the seams and the care someone took with them.

Today we work with a handful of mills and workshops we visit every season. We make fewer pieces, in small runs, and we fix what we sell.

Values

What we care about

Better materials

Traceable wool, organic cotton and leather from tanneries we have visited.

Made to be mended

Free repairs in the first year, and spare buttons in every pocket.

Fair from start to finish

We pay the workshops we use a fair price and publish who they are.

title: FAQ
content:
Help

Frequently asked questions

Answers to the questions we hear most. Cannot find yours? Our team is happy to help.

Orders

We can change or cancel an order within an hour of it being placed. Write to us with your order number and we will do our best.

Most pieces return each season. Create an account and we will email you when a size you want is back.

Delivery

Standard delivery takes two to four working days. Orders placed before 1pm on a working day leave the same day.

We ship to most of Europe and North America. Delivery options and costs for your address appear at checkout.

Returns and exchanges

Return unworn items within 30 days for a full refund. Returns are free within the country we shipped to.

Start a return from your account and choose exchange. We send the new size as soon as the return is scanned.

Care and repairs

Hand wash or use a wool cycle at 30 degrees, then dry flat. Every piece has care details on its product page.

Yes. Repairs are free in the first year and at cost after that. Contact us and we will send a prepaid label.

title: Size guide
content:
Fit

Size guide

Body measurements in centimetres. Each product page also lists the garment's own measurements.

Women

Men

How to measure

  • Chest: around the fullest part, under your arms
  • Waist: around your natural waistline
  • Hips: around the fullest part of your hips
  • Sleeve: from the centre back of your neck to your wrist

Between two sizes? Our pieces are cut relaxed, so choose the smaller size for a closer fit.
